Before the runs, one call confirmed that the operator's own MCP servers were not loaded. The model was pinned with --model gpt-6-sol. Codex does not report a build string, so model_version stays unrecorded. Reasoning effort and sampling were the harness defaults, and Codex's JSON event stream does not report the effort, so it is not recorded. No container: the local shell environment was inherited. Each cell ran with --until-attempted 20 --max-runs 40, with three conditions measured in parallel from one account. Temporary working directory paths in the agent's answers are redacted to <workdir>.
